title: I will definitely continue this monthly box + 12/21 update
text:
I never would have picked either book, but I thoroughly enjoyed them both. The coffee was too mild for my taste but certainly drinkable. I'm hoping to find a new author to enjoy.
12/21/2020 update: I've upgraded from 4 stars to 5 stars. After only 3 boxes and six books I have already found two new authors to start reading! And have enjoyed every book sent.
label: positive
